specs: Ages 5 and older: May ride as passengers only. ⚠️ For everyone’s safety, please follow all instructions provided by our team throughout the experience.
Everyone who is 37 years old or less needs to have a jetski driver's license over 36 years old does not need a jetski driver's license.
Parasail activity fees must be paid using an approved card method.
Cash is accepted only where policy allows (any deposits or required holds must be paid by card).
Health Conditions/Pregnancy: Participants must be physically fit for our "extreme" activities.
Injuries during activities must be reported to staff immediately for assistance.
Life Jacket Requirement: Always wear your USCG life jacket.
Knowing How to Swim: Participants must be comfortable around water and stay calm if they fall in.
A life jacket is required at all times, so swimming skills aren't necessary as long as participants can remain calm and follow staff instructions to exit the water safely.
Alcohol/Drugs: Participants may not be under the influence of alcohol or drugs at check-in or during activities.
